comment: Leviathan 2.9.1 source (commit c37193d, branch puffy-rc3): the module is listed with "hidden": true in the installed plugin.json, so it cannot be found in the module browser. Nautiloid checks rightExpander.module and requires that module's leftExpander to point back at it, so it is an expander that sits to the LEFT of the module it feeds, which is the opposite of the usual Rack convention; it feeds Iris, and Integral Flux uses it too, for the artwork behind the panel glass. Both buttons carry no printed label. The fractal picture, the location-code readout and the two clipboard buttons are plain widgets with no parameter behind them, so no click on them reaches this feature. A voltage smaller than 0.15V on any of the three jacks is treated as still, because the rate is tested against a 0.015 dead band after being divided by 10.
